name: Bali Social Club
description: is a premium sports and recreation venue in Canggu, Bali, that combines a padel club with a wellness center and a community hangout. It offers facilities like multiple padel courts, a state-of-the-art gym, a swimming pool, and a recovery area with a sauna, ice baths, and steam room. In addition to fitness and wellness, the club has a restaurant and bar, aiming to be a social hub for like-minded people to connect and enjoy active living.
